mentions.name: Reminder
mentions.description: An app and API providing the Quran, the names of Allah, and hadith, built as a slow, patient effort to spread the word of Islam.
mentions.source_excerpt: The second thing I'm working on is the Reminder (https://reminder.dev && https://github.com/asim/reminder). As a muslim I feel like it's my duty to spread the word of Islam and as an engineer I feel like an appropriate way to do that is build an app and API for the Quran, names of Allah and hadith.
